title: Document the not-run cascade after an error or timeout, and decide whether it stays
goal: The "unverified consumption" cascade is written down and its keep-or-change decision recorded
acceptance: docs/PROTOCOL.md states: a model, coding or end-to-end case that ends in `error` (timeout, adapter failure, budget breach) makes the suite's token use unverified (src/index.ts:1001, 1043, 1250), every later non-system case is `not-run` with `Prior model execution has unverified consumption`, the report's `usage.outputTokens` is null and the report is not `complete`; a night operator reruns the not-run cases in a new run (as the 2026-11-27 night did for cad-3d, 9 cases after one 52 s error)

The record says whether the cascade is intended (the budget cannot be proved) and names the alternative (charge the profile's `maxOutputTokens` for the failed case and go on); a behaviour change is a separate step the owner approves, not made here
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; no private reports or consumer data.
validation: npm run check:backlog; npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
